summary: element-guci-util ships time-bombed browser sabotage and self-referential dependency resolution
details: time.js (the package's main entry) calls iconFont() at module top level, so behavior fires when any consumer imports or bundles the package. After 2026-10-01 the payload runs memory/CPU exhaustion loops, injects a full-viewport canvas overlay, and starts a 500ms interval that repeatedly triggers a Blob download named 'index.png.exe', opens https://admin.nikolive.cn/ in a new window, and calls location.reload(true) — denial-of-service against the host web application combined with fake-executable delivery aimed at end users. package.json also declares a dependency on the package's own name ('element-guci-util': '^9.9.9'), so `npm install` resolves and installs a separate version of the same name from the registry, executing whatever code ships in that resolved artifact. Manifest fields are untemplated placeholders ('author': '你的名字', repository url: '你的git仓库地址'), consistent with anonymous publication.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
